archetypes.name: exit-code-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces new action exit codes across three emit sites where a single mis-map can silently skip prompts or abort incorrectly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed --with-plan-size exit-code contract matches the existing plan-emit, validator, pause, and plan-size semantics at every affected call site. Look for wrong precedence between defects, hard triggers, partition requests, pause, config failure, and operational failure, especially where Gate B and discussion-round2 intentionally differ from initial Step 2b. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-io-contract
archetypes.rationale: The change depends on precise stdout/FD3/result-env/stderr behavior and could regress quiet output or #3441 stderr preservation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan against the shell script evidence for output-channel contracts: FD 3 display text, result-env KVs, WARN propagation, stderr handling from classification, and non-flag backward compatibility. Check whether the proposed tests are sufficient to catch KEY=VALUE leakage, missing diagnostics, or accidental reversion of the #3441 stderr fix. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: prompt-flow-sync
archetypes.rationale: The plan edits SKILL and reference prompt surfaces that must stay synchronized while preserving site-specific operator flows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the proposed edits across SKILL.md, approval-gates.md, discussion-rounds.md, flags.md, and script docs for cross-document drift in Step 2b, Step 2b.5, Gate B, and discussion-round2. Focus on missing retained callers, wrong AskUserQuestion options, stale standalone check-plan-size references, and inconsistent override, split, cancel, or pause routing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
